description: Lifelong Alaskan Mary Peltola held a town hall with leaders and members of Alaska American Federation of Teachers (AFT), Alaska Public Employees Association (APEA), Alaska Nurses Association, and the Alaska AFL-CIO in Anchorage to speak directly with Alaska workers, educators, and nurses about the issues most important to them and how she will fight for them as Alaska’s next U.S. Senator.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Alaskans for Mary
title: PHOTOS: Mary Peltola Talks Lowering Costs, Putting Alaska Families First at Town Hall with Alaskans, Labor Leaders, AFT, AFL-CIO, APEA Members - Mary Peltola | Fish, Family, Freedom.
